title: UneceAgriculturalZoneArea
description:
A named, delimited and identified part of a land and or water surface of the globe subject to dedicated uniform
agricultural treatment.

applicableAgriculturalCharacteristic.description: An agricultural characteristic applicable to this agricultural zone area.

appliedAgriculturalApplication.description: A specified agricultural application applied to this agricultural zone area.

designatedSection.description: The designated section, expressed as text, of this agricultural zone area.

harvestedProduce.description: Crop produce harvested from this agricultural zone area.

identifier.description: The identifier for this agricultural zone area.

multiSurfaceTypeCode.description: The code specifying the multi-surface type for this agricultural zone area.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this agricultural zone area.

specifiedLocation.description: The referenced location specified for this agricultural zone area.

specifiedPlot.description: A crop plot specified for this agricultural zone area.

subordinateArea.description: An agricultural zone area subordinate to this agricultural zone area.

thirdPartyIssuedId.description: An identifier issued by a third party for this agricultural zone area.
